sources.title: James Hutton Institute — raspberry program highlights
sources.enumerated_scope: All nine cultivar names in the program overview. The page reports a lifetime portfolio of 23 cultivars, but does not enumerate that full portfolio.
sources.limitations: This overview leaves the lifetime portfolio incomplete. Current and historical release lists remain to be checked. No publication date is shown; release years, commercial status, traits, rights and company roles are not approved.

sources.title: USDA ARS Corvallis — FY2022 berry program report
sources.enumerated_scope: All seven named cultivars in the main Progress Report and Accomplishments. Repeated names are counted once; linked publications are a separate research scope.
sources.limitations: A historical annual report, not a complete or current USDA portfolio. Zodiac, Celestial, Thunderhead and Finnberry are tentative names in the FY2022 progress section; later wording on the same page describes releases. Chester is a comparator and UCD Royal Royce a genome-research subject, not USDA release assignments. FY2022 and the 2026 page modification are not publication dates. No current patents, traits, growing regions or breeder roles are approved.

sources.title: University of Georgia — blueberry breeding history
sources.enumerated_scope: All 12 quoted cultivar or wild-selection labels in the main history: four release names and eight explicitly identified wild selections. Wild selections remain visible in exclusions, not imported as released cultivars.
sources.limitations: A program history, not a complete release list. The stated 39 cultivars refers specifically to NeSmith, not these four names or the full program lifetime. The linked licensing listing remains inaccessible. Historical years and photos are not a publication date or confirmed cultivar traits, acreage, current availability, rights or growing locations. Excluding wild selections from this release check does not reject them as germplasm or possible identities in other sources.
